DataSource.query:
Select distinct 'Total Book' as Vtotal, 
case COD_ACCOUNTING_CODE when 'A' then 'Analytics' else 'General' end as 'Compta',
COD_ACCOUNTING_CODE as SOCOM ,
 concat(COD_ACCOUNTING_CODE,COD_ACCOUNTING_LOG) as Origin
from 
COMMON.DIM_ACCOUNTING_LOG AL, 
COMMON.DIM_ACCOUNTING_CODE AC
